calendar.event.get.desc: Returns events on the specified calendar.
calendar.event.get.summary: Returns events on the specified calendar.

calendar.event.get1.desc: Returns an event based on its Google Calendar ID. To retrieve an event using its iCalendar ID, call the events.list method using the iCalUID parameter.
calendar.event.get1.summary: Returns an event based on its Google Calendar ID

calendar.event.quickAdd.create.desc: Creates an event based on a simple text string.
calendar.event.quickAdd.create.summary: Creates an event based on a simple text string.

calendar.me.calendarList.list.desc: Returns the calendars on the user's calendar list.
calendar.me.calendarList.list.summary: Returns the calendars on the user's calendar list.

gmail.user.messages.get.desc: Lists the messages in the user's mailbox. For more information, see [List Gmail messages](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/list-messages).
gmail.user.messages.get.summary: Lists the messages in the user's mailbox

gmail.user.profile.get.desc: Gets the current user's Gmail profile.
gmail.user.profile.get.summary: Gets the current user's Gmail profile.
